subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar as diversas formas de manifestação da vida em seus diferentes níveis de organização, bem como as condições ambientais favoráveis e os fatores limitantes a elas, com ou sem o uso de dispositivos e aplicativos digitais (como softwares de simulação e de realidade virtual, entre outros).

components.description_pt: Identificar formas de manifestação da vida em diferentes níveis de organização biológica
components.description_en: Identify forms of life manifestation across different levels of biological organization
components.cc_component_description: Identify the hierarchical levels of organization from cells to organ systems within multicellular organisms

components.description_pt: Analisar condições ambientais favoráveis associadas a diferentes formas de vida
components.description_en: Analyze favorable environmental conditions associated with different life forms
components.cc_component_description: Explain why different kinds of organisms are found in different environmental conditions

components.description_pt: Identificar fatores limitantes que restringem a manifestação de vida em diversos níveis biológicos
components.description_en: Identify limiting factors that constrain life manifestation at various biological levels
components.cc_component_description: Identify biotic and abiotic factors that influence the survival of an organism in an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Usar simulações digitais para explorar organização biológica e condições ambientais
components.description_en: Use digital simulations to explore biological organization and environmental conditions
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data from computer simulations to describe how Earth's systems respond to human-driven changes

cc_matches.description: Develop and use a model to illustrate the hierarchical organization of interacting systems that provide specific functions within multicellular organisms.
There are many different kinds of living things in any area, and they exist in different places on land and in water.
Organisms, and populations of organisms, are dependent on their environmental interactions both with other living things and with nonliving factors.

Through computer simulations and other studies, important discoveries are still being made about how the ocean, the atmosphere, and the biosphere interact and are modified in response to human activities.
